29354189.finding: The paper proposes iGRN, a method that incorporates multi-omics data (gene expression, copy number variations, and DNA methylations) and their interactions for integrative gene regulatory network inference, showing better performance than other integrative methods on simulation and psychiatric disorder data.

41493977.finding: The study applies DIABLO-based integration of DNA methylation, gene expression, and proteomic data with STRING-based topology analysis and XGBoost classifiers to classify early-stage Parkinson's disease patients versus healthy controls.

39391717.finding: The study integrates multi-omics and single-cell multi-omics data to explore the cis-regulatory roles of orphan CpG islands and enhancers in the transcriptional regulatory network of glioma.

37143094.finding: The study uses an integrative network fusion strategy combining clinical transcriptomics, phenomics, and metabolomics from clinical cohorts and adjuvant-induced arthritis rat models to identify biomarkers and classify rheumatoid arthritis patient subtypes in TCM.

36438626.finding: The review discusses the current status and prospects of integrating multi-omics technologies (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, epigenomics, metabolomics, microbiome) with pan-omics platforms and systems biology for crop improvement.

36187912.finding: The paper introduces a multi-omics integration method combining UMAP-based gene similarity networks with convolutional neural networks, embedding gene expression, DNA methylation, and copy number alteration into 2D RGB images for cancer prediction.

41708984.finding: The study uses an integrative systems biology approach combining multi-omics datasets to characterize BRAF/MAPK inhibitor resistance mechanisms and identify key resistance nodes (PRKD1, JUN, NCK1) in ARID1A-knockout melanoma cells.

38163104.finding: The paper proposes a method integrating copy number alteration, DNA methylation, and gene expression into 2D maps via PaCMAP dimensionality reduction, visualized with RGB coloring and processed by a CNN to forecast Gleason scores in prostate cancer.

36104347.finding: The paper evaluates and compares two network-based multi-omics integration approaches (Similarity Network Fusion for network-level fusion versus feature-level fusion of Patient Similarity Networks) for clinical outcome prediction in neuroblastoma.

38670415.finding: The study proposes OmicsGAN, a Generative Adversarial Network-based method (code available on GitHub) for integrating gene expression and DNA methylation data to improve AML cancer phenotype prediction and drug screening.

39490710.finding: The study integrates network pharmacology with transcriptomics and proteomics to investigate the renal protective mechanisms of Fangji Huangqi Decoction in treating IgA nephropathy, identifying hub targets and signaling pathways.

39800872.finding: scMI is a heterogeneous graph embedding framework that integrates scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq by learning cross-modality relationships between genes and peaks via an inter-type attention mechanism, outperforming database-dependent methods on modality prediction, cell clustering and gene regulatory network inference.
39800872.model: single-cell RNA-seq and ATAC-seq (paired/unpaired human/mouse multi-omics)

33822890.finding: DeepDRK is a deep-learning framework that integrates pharmacogenomics (genomics, transcriptomics, epigenomics, chemical properties and drug–target interactions) via kernel-based similarity matrices to predict drug response and prioritize repurposing candidates.
33822890.model: pan-cancer cell line pharmacogenomics (genomics, transcriptomics, epigenomics, chemical)

41463537.finding: MOGOLA is a graph-based deep-learning framework combining GCN/GAT intra-omics feature extraction with gating and cross-omics attention fusion, and was shown to outperform eleven state-of-the-art methods on BRCA, KIPAN, ROSMAP and LGG multi-omics benchmarks.
41463537.model: human cancer multi-omics (BRCA, KIPAN, ROSMAP, LGG)

38887194.finding: CCAN is a cell-cycle-aware network that removes cell-cycle confounding while integrating paired and unpaired scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq data and transferring labels between modalities.
38887194.model: single-cell RNA-seq and ATAC-seq (human/mouse hematopoietic differentiation)

38857453.finding: Subtype-MGTP is a cancer-subtyping framework that translates multi-type genomics into predicted proteomics and applies contrastive deep subspace clustering, outperforming nine state-of-the-art subtyping methods.
38857453.model: human cancer multi-omics (genomics translated to proteomics)

30984238.finding: HOPES fuses similarity matrices from gene expression, DNA methylation and microRNA data using high-order connected paths with incremental commonality constraints to integrate tumor omics and identify clinically distinct subgroups.
30984238.model: human cancer TCGA multi-omics (gene expression, DNA methylation, miRNA)

42737415.finding: The study benchmarks sixteen multi-omics integration methods on a synthetic COAD dataset, finding that Balanced Latent Integration with Stability Selection (BLISS) achieved the highest silhouette width and ARI, and validates the pipeline on TCGA COAD and CPTAC cohorts.
42737415.model: human colon adenocarcinoma multi-omics (synthetic + TCGA + CPTAC)

41855231.finding: The paper systematically evaluates six similarity network construction strategies within a GCN+VCDN multi-omics classifier on BRCA and ROSMAP, finding Cosine Similarity outperforms kernel-based and hybrid designs in accuracy, F1, AUC and variance.

42089753.finding: A systematic benchmark of 20 statistical, machine-learning and deep-learning multi-omics biomarker identification methods across five cancer datasets shows DeePathNet and DeepKEGG perform best, with biomarker recovery linked to biological-knowledge integration and multivariate feature attribution.

42249649.finding: An application study integrates single-cell and bulk transcriptomic data from ischemic cardiomyopathy patients and benchmarks 127 machine-learning feature-selection combinations to derive a 5-gene fibroblast-associated diagnostic signature and candidate therapeutics.
42249649.model: human ischemic cardiomyopathy (transcriptomics only: scRNA-seq + bulk RNA-seq)

41319559.finding: An uncertainty-aware multi-view framework combines subjective-logic neural networks with Dempster-Shafer fusion and a dynamic, patient-specific decision mechanism that adds omics views only when prediction confidence is insufficient, evaluated on ROSMAP, LGG, BRCA and KIPAN.
41319559.model: human disease multi-omics (ROSMAP, LGG, BRCA, KIPAN)

42419494.finding: scCLIP is a contrastive masked-reconstruction framework for paired single-cell multi-omics (e.g., CITE-seq RNA+ADT) with bidirectional cross-modal contrastive and masked-reconstruction losses, achieving the highest ARI/FMI over TotalVI, BREMSC, jointDIMMSC, scMM and SCOIT on five paired RNA-protein datasets and the NeurIPS 2021 BMGC benchmark.
42419494.model: single-cell paired multi-omics (CITE-seq RNA + surface protein, BMMC)

40794946.finding: scDCT is a probabilistic deep learning framework integrating modality-specific autoencoders with conditional denoising diffusion models for bidirectional cross-modality translation across scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, and protein expression, outperforming state-of-the-art methods on eight benchmark datasets.

42231595.finding: This review systematically examines how transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, epigenomics, and single-cell omics each contribute to populating adverse outcome pathway (AOP) networks and discusses emerging frameworks for their quantitative integration.

42069597.finding: The authors developed a pan-viral framework that integrates genome-wide perturbation screens, single-cell transcriptomes, and viral interactomes via graph-based and classical machine learning to prioritize host dependency factors across four RNA viruses (ROC-AUC > 0.90).
42069597.model: viral host dependency factors (SARS-CoV-2, influenza A, dengue, Zika) integrating perturbation, scRNA-seq, interactomes

42286785.finding: A Bayesian optimization (TPE) framework is presented for automated fine-tuning of scGPT on CITE-seq and GSE194122 multi-omics benchmarks, substantially improving biological conservation and batch integration metrics over default configurations.

40825083.finding: PLNMFG is a non-negative matrix factorization model with pseudo-label guidance and graph Laplacian constraint that performs joint latent representation and cluster structure learning for single-cell multi-omics clustering, with adaptive per-omic weighting and dropout imputation.

42090418.finding: scHG is a scalable high-order graph learning framework built on a supercell paradigm (angle-aware similarity, second-order co-occurrence neighbors, degree-centrality pruning) with an omics-weighted optimizer that improves ARI/NMI by ~4% while reducing runtime by ~26% on six multi-omics benchmarks up to 30,672 cells.
42090418.model: single-cell/bulk multi-omics (transcriptomics, surface proteins, chromatin accessibility) up to ~30k cells

42378996.finding: The study applies multi-omics data fusion (DIABLO modelling) to untargeted LC-HRMS and GC×GC-MS metabolomics of Robusta coffees roasted at different speeds, linking chemical markers to sensory descriptors.
42378996.model: untargeted metabolomics (LC-HRMS, GC×GC-MS) of Coffea canephora

41041566.finding: An AI-based Network Integration method is proposed that models within-omics connectivity conditioned on structured influences from other omics layers, applied to genetics, glycomics (IgG N-glycans), and lipidomics (SPMs) data on immune/inflammatory pathways.
41041566.model: human multi-omics (genetics, glycomics, lipidomics) in immune/inflammatory study (N=266-456)

39073027.finding: Using Monti consensus clustering and Similarity Network Fusion to integrate six -omics blocks (transcriptomics, GSVA, SomaSCAN, shotgun proteomics, 16S microbiome, shotgun metagenomics) from U-BIOPRED sputum samples, five omics-associated clusters were identified distinguishing severe asthma endotypes.
39073027.model: human sputum multi-omics (transcriptomics, proteomics, microbiome/metagenomics) from U-BIOPRED asthma cohort

35610020.finding: This narrative review summarizes network-pharmacology-based integration strategies in Traditional Chinese Medicine, including combinations with multi-omics, gut microbiota, chemical information, data-mining, and network toxicology.
35610020.model: network pharmacology for Traditional Chinese Medicine

40710368.finding: Plasma proteomics and metabolomics from ERMS, ARMS, and controls were integrated using DIABLO and MOFA alongside WGCNA/WMCNA co-expression networks to reveal subtype-specific molecular pathways and biomarker signatures in rhabdomyosarcoma.
40710368.model: pediatric plasma proteomics and metabolomics in rhabdomyosarcoma (ERMS/ARMS)

35723402.finding: Microarray and RNA-Seq transcriptomes were integrated with published GWAS via literature mining and PPI/gene regulatory network analysis to identify hub genes (e.g., CXCR1, HCK, IL1RN) and pathways underlying bovine mastitis.
35723402.model: bovine multi-omics (microarray, RNA-Seq, GWAS) for mastitis

41576957.finding: A multi-omics study of 628 Emirati adults profiling oral microbiome (97 obese, 95 controls) identifies microbial and metabolite signatures correlated with obesity-related cardiometabolic markers.

38862604.finding: A six-month longitudinal multi-omics study of four astronauts integrates metagenomics, metatranscriptomics and single-nuclei immune profiling across 750 samples and 10 body sites to characterize microbiome shifts during short-term spaceflight.

36238598.finding: Multi-omics analysis (microbiome, metabolome, transcriptome) of Chinese rhesus macaques reveals age-related oral and gut microbial changes and reduced tryptophan-derived AhR ligands.
36238598.model: rhesus macaques, oral/gut microbiome + metabolome + transcriptome

41421350.finding: Integrative metagenomic and metabolomic analysis of >1,100 children with ASD identifies microbial genomic variants, pathways, and metabolites linked to autism spectrum disorder for diagnostic modeling.

39227984.finding: Integrative 16S rRNA, untargeted metabolomics and clinical data from 54 first-trimester pregnant women reveal periodontitis-associated oral-gut microbial and metabolic signatures.

33382980.finding: The Cancer Microbiome Atlas (TCMA) provides a curated, decontaminated microbial composition resource from TCGA samples with a statistical decontamination model, enabling systematic matched microbe-host multi-omic analyses.
33382980.model: human (TCGA cancer tissues), tissue microbiome + host genomics

37199635.finding: Integrated gut microbiome, fecal/serum metabolome and clinical data from FGR and normal pregnancies reveal microbial-metabolite interactions associated with fetal growth restriction.

39812341.finding: A multi-omics machine learning approach combining 16S amplicons (standing/active), host transcriptomics, epigenomics and genetics from 142 IBD biopsies predicts relapse within four years better than single-omics analyses.
39812341.model: human (IBD patients), gut mucosal microbiome + host multi-omics

36758521.finding: Combined stool metagenomics and plasma metabolomics in short- and long-term ME/CFS patients versus controls identify microbial and metabolic dysbiosis signatures differing by disease duration.
36758521.model: human (ME/CFS patients), gut microbiome + plasma metabolome

36503572.finding: An integrative multi-omics approach simultaneously profiles GIT microbial communities (bacteria, viruses, archaea) across five regions along with host liver/muscle/urine/serum metabolomics and transcriptomics in sika deer at three developmental stages.
36503572.model: sika deer (Cervus nippon), GIT microbiome + host metabolome/transcriptome

40783429.finding: Longitudinal multi-omics (WGS, protein immunoassays, metabolomics, 16S rRNA) of 19 Emirati patients undergoing bariatric surgery identifies microbial genera, metabolites and genetic variants associated with T2D and CVD risk changes.
40783429.model: human (T2D/prediabetes), gut microbiome + metabolome + host genetics

40849632.finding: A spatial host-microbiome profiling approach combining spatial transcriptomics, in-situ polyadenylation and shotgun metagenomics with a custom bioinformatics pipeline identifies bacterial species and cell-type-specific host transcriptional alterations in pediatric ileal Crohn's disease.
40849632.model: human (pediatric Crohn's disease), ileal tissue microbiome + spatial transcriptome

34762640.finding: This study compares network normalization and propagation methods for multi-omics integration, highlighting topology bias risks and proposing parameter optimization strategies that maximize agreement between proteome and transcriptome layers.
34762640.model: rat (brain, liver), human (prostate cancer); proteome and transcriptome

38295113.finding: The paper presents POPLS-DA, a novel probabilistic multi-omics data integration method, together with an R/markdown workflow that jointly analyzes transcriptomics, proteomics, and drug screening data from LUHMES cell lines for synucleinopathy research.
38295113.model: human LUHMES cell lines; transcriptomics, proteomics, drug screening

36794912.finding: Using similarity network fusion (SNF) on plasma lipidomics, metabolomics, and fecal 16S microbiome data, the study stratifies treated HIV-infected individuals into metabolic at-risk clusters, illustrating a multi-omics integration application.

38969985.finding: The authors introduce MTBE-SP3, a unified single-sample workflow integrating metabolite extraction (EtOH/MTBE) with automated proteome preparation (autoSP3) for combined metabolomic and proteomic analysis across multiple clinical matrices.
38969985.model: human clinical specimens (FFPE, fresh-frozen tissue, plasma, serum, cells); metabolomics and proteomics

39026781.finding: OpenPedCan provides a harmonized multi-omic pediatric cancer dataset (>6,000 patients) with reproducible dockerized Nextflow/CWLS pipelines spanning WGS, RNA-seq, proteomics, phospho-proteomics, miRNA-Seq, and methylation, deployable locally or on AWS.
39026781.model: human (pediatric cancer); WGS, WXS, RNA-seq, proteomics, phospho-proteomics, miRNA-Seq, methylation

35574063.finding: nf-rnaSeqCount is a Nextflow/Singularity pipeline that maps RNA-seq reads and generates raw count matrices, designed as a reproducible single-omics building block usable within broader multi-omics pipelines.

38292471.finding: HiOmics is a cloud-based platform with ~300 plugins, Docker containerization, WDL/Cromwell workflows, and object-storage-based batch computing for comprehensive analysis and visualization of large-scale omics data.

36760650.finding: The Variety Test Platform (VTP) manages phenotypic data and workflow for crop variety testing across multiple locations and traits; it is not a multi-omics integration tool.

28954542.finding: The review discusses standardization efforts for synthetic biology parts and workflows, mentioning under-exploited multi-omics datasets but not presenting any integration software.

24060123.finding: The chapter describes a sequential wet-lab workflow for isolating metabolites, RNA, DNA, and proteins from the same undivided microbial sample, serving as a foundation protocol for integrative multi-omics analyses.
24060123.model: microbial communities (wastewater, freshwater, human); metabolites, RNA, DNA, proteins

42683156.finding: tidyexposomics is an open-source tidyverse-native R package delivering an end-to-end exposure-omics workflow that includes ontology annotation, QC, association testing, multi-omics integration, network analysis, and functional enrichment.

39436599.finding: The chapter demonstrates a proteogenomic workflow for discovering novel proteoforms that combines proteomics and genomics software tools within the Galaxy web platform to address reproducibility and accessibility challenges.

40823862.finding: Application study integrating microbiome and transcriptome sequencing of prepuce samples from MGLSc patients and controls to investigate host-microbe interactions and differential gene expression in urethral strictures.
40823862.model: human (male genital lichen sclerosus patients, tissue microbiome + transcriptome)

39650020.finding: Multi-omics analysis integrating transcriptomic and metagenomic data from severe udder cleft dermatitis lesions versus healthy udder skin in dairy cattle, revealing correlations between the pathogen Streptococcus pyogenes and virulence factors/host genes.
39650020.model: bovine (dairy cow udder skin microbiome + transcriptome)

41308639.finding: Profiling the microbiome and metabolome of Bangladeshi mother-infant dyads over the first 6 months, multi-omics analysis reveals specific microbial-metabolite relationships linking environmental and maternal factors to gut metabolic development.
41308639.model: human (infant and maternal gut microbiome + metabolome)

39655222.finding: Proposes a new sparse canonical correlation analysis framework for integrating compositional microbiome data with other high-dimensional omics, incorporating grouping structure priors and outperforming existing methods on simulations and real microbiome multi-omics data.
39655222.model: microbiome multi-omics integration (microbiome + host omics datasets)

41751306.finding: Narrative mini-review summarizing how multi-omics technologies and AI are being applied to modernize gastric biopsy diagnostics for precision classification and risk stratification.

35251962.finding: Reviews radiomics and deep learning methods for quantitative imaging feature extraction and analysis, with discussion of roles in multimodality and multi-omics studies.

42496805.finding: Delphi-based expert consensus providing recommendations on AI application scenarios in clinical cancer imaging across screening, diagnosis, treatment, and implementation.

42778966.finding: Discusses standards, infrastructures and analytical practices needed to make proteomics data reusable and interoperable for multi-omics integration and clinical translation, highlighting metadata gaps and workflow reproducibility issues.

41181553.finding: Bibliometric and knowledge-mapping analysis of global research on AI-driven histopathology image interpretation in oncology from 2000–2024.

42323537.finding: Describes MetaServe, an open-source governance and delivery layer for managing heterogeneous pre-publication multi-omics assets with metadata-aware indexing, role-based access, and workflow handoff in institutional settings.

31953809.finding: Reviews the metabolomics workflow from data processing and QC to pathway analysis and multi-omics integration, including reporting and reproducibility recommendations.

41515227.finding: Narrative review of AI and multi-omics applications for precision nutrition in the ICU, focusing on implementation barriers and ethics rather than specific integration tools.

38924840.finding: Exploratory multi-omics study integrating skin metagenomic shotgun sequencing with skin transcriptomics using WGCNA and cell deconvolution to link host antiviral responses with skin microbes in psoriasis.

35995842.finding: Integrates sputum metagenome, metabolome, host transcriptome and proteome from COPD patients using sequential mediation analysis to identify microbe-metabolite-host interaction hypotheses such as tryptophan/IAA/IL-22.
35995842.model: human airway microbiome, metabolome, transcriptome, proteome

39020083.finding: Applies DIABLO supervised multi-omics integration to paired tumor microbiome and plasma metabolome data to discriminate early-onset from average-onset colorectal cancer and identify host-microbiome associations.

41482560.finding: Applies deep multi-omics phenotyping across 1,408 individuals to define a metabolome-informed obesity metric and uses mediation analysis to characterize bidirectional adipose-microbiome interactions.
41482560.model: human adipose tissue + plasma metabolome + microbiome
